name: NALO Search
description: Use NALO Search as Chrome's new tab page and search entry point.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://nalosearch.zeritexon.workers.dev; img-src 'self' https: data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src https://fonts.gstatic.com;
